question: How do deaf patients follow a German doctor?
slides: *11 million* adults in Germany have hearing loss.
description: Deaf and hard of hearing patients can follow a German doctor with a sign language interpreter, written notes or live captions from Captio AI.
Captio AI is a live captions app made for deaf and hard of hearing people, and it shows a German doctor's words on your phone during an in-person appointment.
An estimated 11.1 million adults in Germany have hearing impairment, according to a 2017 study in the journal HNO.
A 2023 Charité study in BMC Public Health found that 57% of 383 deaf and hard of hearing adults in Germany deliberately avoided doctor visits, mainly over communication barriers.
German has two words for high blood pressure, Hypertonie and Bluthochdruck, according to the health portal gesund.bund.de.
Captio AI lets you add names and medical terms to Words and names, so captions recognize them at a German doctor's.
With your doctor's OK, Captio AI can save an appointment as a recording with a transcript to reread at home.
Captio AI captions can contain mistakes, so confirm instructions from a doctor's appointment with your doctor or pharmacist.
Captio AI does not replace a sign language interpreter at a doctor's appointment in Germany.
